title: Solution Architect, Enterprise - French Speaking
searchText: Solution Architect, Enterprise - French Speaking Fivetran  From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a French Speaking Enterprise Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team. The Professional Services team in Fivetran works across all segments and use cases, with a focus not only on onboarding and initial implementation, but building relationships with our customers to facilitate wider adoption of the tool, turning power-users into advocates. The Solution Architect role is extremely diverse. You will act as a liaison between customers, Product and Engineering; the Fivetran architect in charge of solution design alongside hands-on work in the form of installation, configuration and development. Solution Architects may work alone or in teams, and depending on the customer, may occasionally work on-site with customers in person. Solution Architects are also expected to manage the timelines and delivery of their customer work, work with one another, and work with other internal Fivetran stakeholders. Further to your work with customers, the Solution Architect function provides cross-functional support across the organisation. You will support Marketing through attendance at industry events, with opportunities to take on speaking engagements, and you will work closely with Fivetran’s Product team on Feature Requests and product development. You will be joining a multi-talented team of peers with locations across Europe. We value team cohesion and run internal business reviews in person to foster collaboration and alignment, and to maintain the personal connections that make this team as strong as it is. This Enterprise Solution Architecture position is a full-time, remote role based in France, and travel is expected approximately 10-15% of the time. Technologies You’ll Use Data Sources: Applications (Salesforce, Google Ads, etc), Databases (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, etc), Events (Kafka, Kinesis, etc), Files (S3, SFTP, etc.) Data Targets: Data Lakes (Iceberg, Delta), Data Warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, etc.) Container Technology: Docker/Podman, Kubernetes Languages: SQL, Python, bash or PowerShell, other languages are nice-to-have Networking: SSH tunnelling, VPNs, Privatelink What You’ll Do Manage customer engagements, with a focus on ensuring customer success through implementation, adoption and expansion of Fivetran Deliver solution design following industry and Fivetran best practices, whilst keeping in mind customer requirements Work alongside the wider Account team to develop and execute the adoption of Fivetran’s products Act as a primary liaison point between your customers, Product and Engineering Provide value-added support to adjacent organisations, such as Marketing and Customer Support Contribute to internal initiatives, such as the development of business processes to enhance the Fivetran stakeholder experience Skills We’re Looking For Fluency in both French and English Proven ability to take ownership and accountability for the success of their customers and customer projects Being self-motivated, proactive and organised when working with customers and internal stakeholders alike A dedicated team player who values quality and collaborates to help everyone succeed Being comfortable in deep technical conversations as well as managing customer relationships Bonus Skills​ Previous experience with any of the following: Fivetran dbt, including any certificate accreditations The major cloud vendors (AWS, Azure & GCP), including any solution architecture accreditations Project Management accreditation #LI-LA1 #LI-REMOTE Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
